blind.description: A stylized carved stone statue of a knight or guardian in full plate armor. The figure wears a crested helmet, heavy shoulder pauldrons, chest armor, and greaves, resting both hands on the top rim of a large shield set vertically in front. The material is weathered grey stone accented with patches of green moss, cleanly modeled with continuous, solid surfaces.
blind.from_above: A central crested helmet flanked by wide, rounded pauldrons with mossy patches, with the arms curving forward toward the top edge of the shield below.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6.5 to 7 ft tall including the plinth (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 ft wide across the shoulders/base.
